display: Balarama as Krishna’s Vrindavan-period elder brother
scope: D072 chapter-specific provisional youth-stage contract; separate from the shared Balarama very-young-child contract; not an approved character sheet.

depiction_rules.notes: In D072 Balarama is a youthful cowherd brother beside Krishna, not a toddler. This stage distinction does not revise the shared child-stage contract.

visual_bible.age: youthful cowherd; slightly older-looking than Krishna but both are youths
visual_bible.face: serene and distinct from Krishna, with natural youthful features
visual_bible.skin: natural warm light-brown mural pigment; do not transfer Krishna’s blue skin
visual_bible.build: ordinary youthful human proportions; one face, two attached arms and hands, two legs and feet
visual_bible.clothing: simple cool-blue dhoti with cream or muted red-orange upper cloth, sparse nonmetallic ornament, modestly less elaborate than Krishna’s
visual_bible.continuity_markers: older-brother presence, warm light-brown skin, blue-hued garment, calm expression, ordinary two-arm anatomy

never: no duplicate Krishna identity or blue skin
no extra arms, weapons, crown or glossy ornament
no metallic gold, text, or modern details
